title: Do our playbooks and skills beat the same agent without them?
hypothesis: For each playbook (build-a-website, build-a-product, run-an-experiment), the same model and harness with the playbook loaded passes more gates at equal or lower cost than without it.
human_gate: Frank approves moving any skill into the default prompt. New skills stay out of the default prompt until they have a saved eval.

runs_on.why: T1 run (repeated with/without ablation, n of at least 10 per arm). The laptop never runs T1 or higher, so this waits for the Railway worker.

suite: skills-playbooks-v0 (paired with web-v0 and starlight-core-v0 tasks)
success_rule: A playbook is kept only if its with-versus-without gate pass rate is higher at n of at least 10 per arm and the skill's Turn-0 token cost stays inside the 8,000-token gateway listing cap. Otherwise it is retired or merged.
kill: Stop when a playbook fails its own evals twice. Skills that never trigger are retired.

next_gate.receipt: lab/results/EXP-009.md with the ablation table per playbook

decision_it_feeds: Which playbooks go into starlight-ai-harness and which skills are retired by Skill Foundry.
preconditions: The judge that runs the ablation did not write the skill.
No skill is registered in the default prompt before its eval is saved.
